description: Permissions for the game overlay window: a click-through, non-focusable card that shows who is talking and the last message over a game. It renders and listens; visibility, placement and teardown are decided in Rust, so the window is granted no window-management permissions of its own. `store:default` is required because every window boots through UiRoot, which reads the chosen UI pack out of preferences - without it the design never resolves and the window renders nothing at all.
